fullName.description: Extract only the full name stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer.

email.description: Extract only an email address stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer.

phone.description: Extract only a phone number stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer.

location.description: Extract only a location stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer.

summary.description: Extract only a summary stated verbatim in the CV; do not generate or infer.

gender.description: Extract only gender stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer from names or context.

dateOfBirth.description: Extract only a birth date stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer missing date parts.

experiences.description: Extract only work experience details stated verbatim in the CV; do not infer roles, employers or dates.

other.description: Keep at most 20 additional labeled facts stated verbatim in the CV with source evidence; do not infer or duplicate core fields.
